I have reimplemented the executable `felix` from scratch based on behavioral observation.

### Summary of Implementation
- **CLI & Diagnostics**: Implemented command line options (`--help` / `-h`, `--init`, `--log` / `-l`), path validation error messages, and shell integration script output.
- **Config & Logging**: Added YAML config parsing (`config.yaml`/`config.yml`) supporting options like `default_editor`, `match_vim_exit_behavior`, `default_show_hidden`, and `exec` extension open configurations.
- **TUI & ANSI Rendering**: Built terminal raw mode controls, responsive layout with vertical/horizontal preview splits, status bar, header bar with git repository/branch detection, file list formatting with type-based colors (directories, symlinks, git status red), permissions, sizes, and modification dates.
- **Vim Keybindings & Operations**: Implemented movement (`j`/`k`, `gg`/`G`, `<C-d>`/`<C-u>`, `<C-o>`/`<C-i>`), file/directory creation (`i`/`I`), renaming (`c`), deletion to trash (`dd`), yank/put (`yy`/`p`) with named registers (`"a`), undo/redo (`u` / `<C-r>`), visual mode selection (`V`), preview toggle (`v`/`s`), search (`/`, `n`, `N`), and colon command line mode (`:cd`, `:e`, `:config`, `:trash`, `:empty`, `:h`, `:q`).
- **Archive Unpacking**: Built archive decompression support (`e`).
- **Build & Artifacts**: Created `./compile.sh` to compile the standalone binary using pure Rust stdlib without external crate dependencies, and ensured build artifacts are ignored in `.gitignore` and all source files are committed.
